description:
**Blocked by d06.2. Read deck §4 "Component API" and §5 "Hooks"
before starting.**

Six selector components share a common pattern (list of items,
arrow navigation, optional fuzzy filter, enter-to-select).
Convert all six to VDom; consider extracting a shared
`Components.Selector` higher-order component that takes an
item-renderer function and a key-handler so the six concrete
selectors become thin specializations.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/select_list.ex` (~180 lines).
  The most generic — likely the basis for the shared selector.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/model_selector.ex` (~100 lines).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/session_selector.ex` (~110 lines).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/settings_selector.ex` (~110 lines).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/settings_list.ex` (~120 lines).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex` (~230 lines).
  Most complex — supports collapse/expand and nested children.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/fuzzy.ex` — fuzzy-match
  ranking. Continues to be a side-utility, called from selector
  components.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` — search for
  the dialog branches that mount each selector
  (`render_dialog_overlay/3` clauses for `:model_selector`,
  `:session_selector`, etc., plus the corresponding dialog-state
  fields in `state.ui`).
- Per-component tests under `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/`.

**Target shape:**
- Optional but recommended: a shared `Components.Selector`
  function that takes:
  * `items` — list of items.
  * `render_item` — `fn item, selected?, ctx -> vnode end`.
  * `on_select` — `fn item, state -> state end`.
  * `filter?` — boolean: enable fuzzy-filter input row.
  * Returns: VFlow of (optional filter row) + scrollable item
    list. Internal state (cursor index, filter text) via
    `use_state`. Key handling via `use_key` for arrow keys,
    Enter, Escape.
- Each concrete selector becomes ~30-50 lines: builds props,
  passes to `Components.Selector`, post-processes result.
- TreeSelector remains its own component (collapse/expand state
  is meaningfully different from a flat selector); but it can
  reuse pieces.
- The `render_dialog_overlay/3` branches for these six are
  deleted as part of d06.6's Screen-root collapse — coordinate
  with d06.6 if it's still in flight.

**Acceptance:**
- Each selector's existing tests stay green.
- tmux smoke for each selector trigger (check
  `keybindings.ex` for the activation key per opi-bd5.7+):
  * Model selector (Ctrl+L per opi-bd5.8): activates, fuzzy-filters
    by typing, arrow-nav, Enter selects, Escape cancels.
  * Session selector: same flow.
  * Settings selectors: same flow.
  * Tree selector: arrow nav across nested levels; left-arrow
    collapses, right-arrow expands; Enter selects; Escape
    cancels.
- Modules' `defstruct` and `@behaviour Component` (legacy shape)
  deleted.
- If `Components.Selector` is introduced, document its API in
  the module's @moduledoc.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.
